title: SER Readiness Diagnostic
intro: How ready is your school to write its ACCSC Self-Evaluation Report? Answer 10 quick questions (about 3 minutes) to see where you stand and what to tackle first.

questions.text: Is your school licensed or authorized to operate by your state's education agency?
questions.why: ACCSC only considers institutions that are legally authorized to operate in their state.

questions.text: Has your school been operating continuously, under the same ownership, for at least two years?
questions.why: ACCSC requires an operating history before an institution can apply for initial accreditation.

questions.text: Can you produce graduation and employment rates for each program, from your own records, for your most recent reporting period?
questions.why: Student achievement rates are central to ACCSC review and are compared against benchmarks.

questions.text: Do you keep documentation for each graduate's employment (employer, job title, start date, and how it was verified)?
questions.why: Reported employment has to be supported by records a reviewer can sample.

questions.text: Does every program have a written outline with objectives, hours, and a course sequence that matches what you actually teach?
questions.why: Program documentation is reviewed against what is delivered during the on-site visit.

questions.text: Does each program have an advisory committee of industry practitioners that meets regularly and keeps minutes?
questions.why: Program Advisory Committees are an ACCSC requirement.

questions.text: Do you have a file for each instructor showing qualifications and experience that meet the standard for the subjects they teach?
questions.why: Faculty qualification files are routinely reviewed.

questions.text: Are your admissions, refund, and student complaint policies written, published to students, and applied consistently?
questions.why: These policies are reviewed for both their content and how consistently they are applied.

questions.text: Do you have recent financial statements prepared by an independent accountant?
questions.why: Financial stability is part of the accreditation review.

questions.text: Has someone been named to lead the Self-Evaluation Report, with time set aside and staff from each area involved?
questions.why: The SER is a whole-institution self-study. Schools that treat it as one person's writing task usually run late.

bands.label: Audit Ready
bands.message: Your foundation is solid. The main work now is writing: turning your records into clear, evidence-backed narratives.

bands.label: Action Required / Moderate Exposure
